title: Global Industrial Easy-Steer Heavy-Duty Drum Cradle for 55-Gallon Steel Drums
description: Assembles easily. Quickly move and drain 55 gallon steel drums. One man loading. Heavy gauge steel, retractable handle. 600 lb capacity. 5 polyolefin load wheels, 3 polyolefin swivel casters for maximum maneuverability.
